payload.summary: Outside-in evidence: W3C PROV models provenance as distinct entities, activities, agents, and derivation/responsibility relations, supporting separate resolver, act, and source-link facts rather than flattening them into one inferred label. CloudEvents similarly separates stable event id, type, source context, and time as inspectable metadata independent of event data. Neither standard supports inferring delegation or human authorship from free-text payload claims. Sources: https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-overview/ ; https://www.w3.org/groups/wg/prov/publications/ ; https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/spec.md
